operating_notes.text: Statutory auditors issued a disclaimer of opinion on the FY26 standalone and consolidated financial statements.
The company wrote off ₹38,148.21 lakhs of old receivables and inventories as exceptional items in FY26 without restating prior years.

timeline.summary: Chief Financial Officer Shri Prasad Barre resigned effective April 30, 2026.
ITI Limited published its Annual Report for FY2025-26, highlighting a disclaimer of opinion from statutory auditors and a steep decline in revenue.
